name: ccc-reporter
description: CC Command Center's reporter: sends this session's state to the app over an authenticated channel, relays the app's answers to prompts, and submits prompts the app relays. Loaded with --plugin-dir on sessions the app launches.

socketPath.title: App socket
socketPath.description: Absolute path of this session's Unix socket

secret.title: Session secret
secret.description: 64 hex characters: the HMAC key this session shares with the app

channelRoot.title: Channel folder
channelRoot.description: Absolute path of the folder holding every session's channel; never granted by remember

replyKey.title: App reply key
replyKey.description: 64 hex characters: the app's Ed25519 public key, which every reply must be signed with
